\section{Conservation Law}
\label{sec:conservation}

Along every lattice trajectory the density satisfies
\begin{equation}
\label{eq:flux-law}
\partial_t \rho_n + J_{n+1} - J_n = 0.
\end{equation}

\appendix
\section{Commutator Appendix}
\label{sec:appendix}

In this appendix we record the tagged quadratic commutator identity:
\begin{equation}
\label{eq:commutator-identity}
[A, B^2] = [A, B]B + B[A, B]. \tag{A1}
\end{equation}
